stemMd: A club allows a member to borrow equipment only after training. Members who complete training and pay a deposit may borrow equipment unless their membership is suspended. Which fact guarantees borrowing permission?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The member has completed training, paid the deposit, and has an unsuspended membership.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The member has belonged to the club for many years.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The member promises to pay the deposit later.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The member completed training but has been suspended.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The member has paid the deposit but skipped training.

explanationMd: Check the conjunction of training and payment, then exclude suspension. All three facts together satisfy the permission rule. No single positive fact in the other choices is a substitute for the complete condition.

distractorRationale.b: Seniority is not a permission condition.
distractorRationale.c: A promise does not satisfy the paid-deposit requirement.
